review.summary: Scope reviewed: display labels and step/popup reference selectors in funnel-element-inspector.tsx. Labels are wired correctly to referenceOptions, and option values stay the original IDs. No BLOCKER. One MAJOR: the popup selector can show "請選擇" while a stale popupId remains in state and is persisted, and the step selector has no guard symmetry. There are also MINOR issues: a silent no-op on a stale step, local state that is not resynced after external changes, and an empty-step-list case with no feedback. Findings assume getFunnelInspectorFieldValue and createFunnelInspectorActionUpdate behave as their names imply; neither was supplied. This is not a WP08 certification.

findings.issue: A stale or deleted popupId is shown as "請選擇" but kept in state and can be re-applied; apply() validates stepId against stepIds but never validates popupId against popupIds.
findings.evidence: initialAction copies action.popupId into state. The select uses value={action.popupId ?? ""} with options only from popupIds. If the id is absent from popupIds, no option matches and the browser displays the first option ("請選擇"). apply() only has a membership guard for next_step; show_popup goes straight to createFunnelInspectorActionUpdate(node, action).
findings.impact: The label ("請選擇" = nothing chosen) disagrees with the value (a dangling popup id). Clicking "套用動作" persists a reference to a nonexistent popup with no feedback. The select is disabled when popupIds is empty, but the apply button is not.
findings.recommended_fix: Mirror the next_step guard: reject popupId not in popupIds. Also render the unknown current id as an explicit option (e.g. "（已不存在）<id>") or clear it on load, and disable/explain apply when there is nothing valid to apply.
findings.required_test: Render with node action show_popup popupId='gone' and popupIds=['p1']: assert the selector does not silently show '請選擇' as the stored value (shows missing marker), and clicking apply does not emit a command containing 'gone'. Also popupIds=[] with show_popup: apply emits no command.

findings.issue: A stale stepId is displayed as "請選擇" and apply() silently returns with no user-visible feedback.
findings.evidence: apply(): `if (action.type === "next_step" && stepIds && !stepIds.includes(action.stepId ?? "")) return;` with no message or state change. The select's value is not among the options when the step was removed, so it renders the placeholder.
findings.impact: The user clicks "套用動作" and nothing happens; the stored reference stays stale, and the UI gives no cue as to why.
findings.recommended_fix: Show an inline error/status when a step is blocked (or when stepId is missing/unknown), and surface the unknown stored id as a labelled missing option. Optionally disable apply while invalid.
findings.required_test: With stepIds=['s1'] and node next_step stepId='s9', click apply: assert no command and a visible validation message; select 's1' then apply: command emitted with stepId 's1'.

findings.issue: Local action draft is initialized once per node id and is not resynced when node.actions changes externally (undo/redo, other commands) or when popupIds/stepIds change.
findings.evidence: useState lazy initializer runs once; the only reset key is node.id. Undo/redo of the action via onCommand history changes node.actions on the same node id without remounting.
findings.impact: The displayed type/target label can differ from the actual node value after undo/redo, and the user may re-apply a stale draft over the real state.
findings.recommended_fix: Include a serialization of node.actions[0] (or a revision) in the key, or derive/reset draft state in an effect when node.actions changes.
findings.required_test: Apply a popup action, undo through history, and assert the inspector selector reflects the reverted action; rerender with changed node.actions on same id and assert the fields update.

findings.issue: When stepIds is an empty array, the step selector is rendered enabled with only "請選擇" and no empty-state message, unlike the popup selector.
findings.evidence: popup: disabled={... || !popupIds.length} plus an amber hint. next_step: `stepIds ? <select disabled={disabled}> ...` with no length check or hint, and apply() silently returns because includes("") is false.
findings.impact: The user sees a selector with no choices and a button that does nothing, with no explanation.
findings.recommended_fix: Disable the select and show an empty-state hint when stepIds.length === 0; keep apply disabled.
findings.required_test: Render next_step with stepIds=[]: select is disabled, hint visible, apply emits no command.

findings.area: ActionFields popup/next_step label wrappers; FieldControl select
findings.issue: Warning text and select options live inside the wrapping <label>, so the accessible name of the select includes extra text; FieldControl selects with a value outside field.options also display "未設定".
findings.evidence: The popup warning <span> is a child of the <label> containing the select. FieldControl uses value={String(value)} with a fixed "未設定" option and field.options only.
findings.impact: Noisy accessible names; possible label/value mismatch for unknown stored select values (depends on getFunnelInspectorFieldValue, not supplied).
findings.recommended_fix: Use aria-describedby for the hint instead of nesting in the label; consider rendering an explicit unknown-value option in FieldControl selects.
findings.required_test: Accessible-name query by label '選擇彈出視窗' returns the select without the hint text; FieldControl select with out-of-range value shows a marked unknown option.
